what: For 01491 (observe, Andrew via coord-1030: a stall names what is running): in crates/blaze-api/src/lib.rs add `Request::Running` (no fields) and `Response::Running { text: String, at_ns: u64 }`: what every daemon thread is inside now, blaze_profile::watchdog::running().to_string(), at the daemon clock. Answered at once by the loop, never queued behind a job (like Status). Bump the schema as your rules say. Tell cargo when it lands: cargo then answers it in serve/daemon.rs and adds `blaze debug running` (prints the text, exit 0) in cli/observe.rs.
